name: github-issues
description: A side pane listing the repository's GitHub issues, with one click to have Claude work on one

commands.title: Issue commands
commands.description: Slash commands an issue card offers when it has no run:<command> label, comma-separated; a press runs /<command> #<number> <url>. Empty: the card's Work on it button.

background.title: Pane background
background.description: A color for the pane's body, as #rrggbb (e.g. #000000); empty keeps Claude Code's own.
